news_items.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals wrap up their weekend series versus the Cincinnati Reds Sunday afternoon at Busch Stadium. For the Cardinals, Kyle Leahy will be the starter while the Reds send lefty Andrew Abbott to the mound. First pitch is scheduled for 1:15pm central time and the game broadcast will be available through Cardinals.tv.
